title: The README shows each feature as a GIF
body:
The README's feature sections hold bold placeholders where a GIF goes: the session picker, the context window, markdown, and marking passages. "a chat that reads like a text thread" shows the still `assets/chat.png`. GIFs go under `assets/`, which `Cargo.toml` already excludes from the crate.

`scenarios/readme/` holds one scenario per feature for `coax-fake-agent` to play, each checked in tmux:

| scenario | what it plays |
|---|---|
| `picker.json` | four earlier sessions, ages 19 hours to a month, each with a short history |
| `thread.json` | a thought, a read, a reply, an edit, a command with output, a second reply, context at 32% |
| `context.json` | one act per prompt, stepping context through 20%, 60%, 85% and 97% |
| `markdown.json` | a heading, a list, a quote, a table, a Rust block too wide for the box, a fenced `markdown` block |
| `marking.json` | a reply with three points, then an answer to `[1]` and `[2]` |

## Proposal

Record each GIF in a decade scratch pane with the `record` tool that decade-7fb578 proposes, then put it in place of its placeholder.

## Open

- The picker's agents row shows the agent's command and arguments. A config that names `coax-fake-agent` by an absolute path puts that path in the recording. The recording config should name the binary bare, with `target/debug` on `PATH`, and the scenario by a relative path.
- The agent's name in that config shows in the picker and in each session row. `fake` reads oddly in a README.
- Until decade-7fb578 lands, `gpu-screen-recorder` and `ffmpeg` can record the pane's region of the screen, measured by hand.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/df584c97
notes.text:
Recording setup, agreed with Jack and checked by screenshot:

- ghostty at `--font-size=18` with `--window-decoration=none`, in a scratch pane dragged to 80 columns by 24 rows. That is 1695 × 1189 pixels inside ghostty, and decade's `record` captures 1749 × 1242.
- `record` with no `width`, so the GIF keeps the captured pixels. 1749 is about twice the width of GitHub's README column, which shows it halved with no blur.
- The scenarios have to fit 24 rows. At 100 columns, the earlier takes left the prompt far to the right of the replies.
- `record` cannot start together with the program, so ghostty sleeps 6 seconds before starting coax. The blank lead-in is cut afterwards.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/df584c97
notes.text: `assets/thread.gif` replaces `assets/chat.png` under "a chat that reads like a text thread". It plays `scenarios/readme/thread.json` through `--input` (coax-573e0f), with the folded run of tool calls from coax-d1bcb7 and the status line filled in. 1749 × 1403, 18 seconds, 504 KB. The other four GIFs are still to record.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/df584c97
notes.text: All four GIFs are recorded and in the README: `assets/picker.gif`, `assets/thread.gif`, `assets/markdown.gif` and `assets/marking.gif`, 140 to 504 KB each, at 1749 pixels wide. At Jack's word the context-window section and `scenarios/readme/context.json` are dropped, since every GIF shows the context bar. Each GIF plays its scenario through `--input`, mouse steps included (coax-d79a59), in ghostty at font size 18 with `--app-notifications=no-clipboard-copy`, which keeps the copy button from raising a toast in the frame. The picker take runs with `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` pointing at a scratch config whose `[agents.claude]` names `coax-fake-agent` bare. Uncommitted.
